title: Anthropic releases its first Mythos-class model Claude Fable
raw_excerpt: Anthropic just announced Claude Fable 5, a new AI model it said is the most powerful model it has ever made widely available. According to the company, Fable 5 "shows exceptional performance in software engineering, knowledge work, and vision," with its lead over other models growing as tasks become longer and more complex. Fable 5 marks the first broad release from Anthropic's Mythos class of AI models, after the company said the family was so capable at cybersecurity tasks that it was too dangerous to release publicly . summary: Anthropic 发布了其 Mythos 类模型的首个广泛版本——Claude Fable 5，号称是该公司迄今为止最强大的模型。该模型在软件工程、知识工作和视觉方面表现卓越，尤其在长时复杂任务上领先优势明显。此前 Anthropic 曾因安全顾虑未公开 Mythos 类模型，此次发布得益于新的安全机制。Fable 5 的推出标志着 AI 能力边界的又一次重大突破。

title: Introducing Gemma 4 12B: a unified, encoder-free multimodal model
summary: Google DeepMind 发布了 Gemma 4 12B，这是一个统一的、无需编码器的多模态模型。该模型在保持较小参数规模的同时，实现了强大的多模态理解能力，可直接处理图像、文本等多种输入。Gemma 4 12B 的开源特性将推动多模态 AI 的普及，为开发者提供高效、灵活的端侧部署方案。

title: Fluid, natural voice translation with Gemini 3.5 Live Translate
raw_excerpt: Gemini 3.5 Live Translate brings near real-time, natural speech translation to Google AI Studio, Google Translate and Google Meet.
summary: Google DeepMind 推出 Gemini 3.5 Live Translate，实现近乎实时的自然语音翻译。该技术已集成到 Google AI Studio、Google Translate 和 Google Meet 中，支持流畅的跨语言对话。Live Translate 通过端到端神经模型，在保留语气和情感的同时大幅降低延迟，为实时翻译场景树立了新标准。

title: I tried Siri AI, and so far it actually works

It can reference information in your email and calendar to make its recommenda … Read the full story at The Verge.
summary: The Verge 记者实测了苹果在 WWDC 2026 上发布的全新 Siri AI，发现其终于能完成用户期待已久的实用功能：从邮件或模糊格式的传单中一次性将足球赛程或“精神周”主题日添加到日历。新版 Siri 还能讨论园艺问题、整理购物清单等。这标志着苹果在 AI 助手领域从落后到追赶的关键转折。

title: German ruling declares Google liable for false answers in AI Overviews
summary: 德国法院作出里程碑式裁决，认定谷歌必须为其 AI Overviews 中的虚假答案承担法律责任，将其视为谷歌自身的言论。这一判决可能重塑全球 AI 生成内容的责任框架，迫使科技公司对其 AI 系统的输出承担更多法律义务，对 AI 搜索和问答产品的商业模式产生深远影响。

title: China's Xiaomi MiMo Is Now 15X Faster Than ChatGPT and Claude
raw_excerpt: Xiaomi and inference partner TileRT have created a 1-trillion-parameter model, MiMo-V2.5-Pro-UltraSpeed, with an inference speed of 1,000 tokens per second on a standard 8-GPU commodity node. The speed was achieved through FP4 quantization on the model's expert layers and DFlash speculative decoding, which proposes a full block of tokens in one pass instead of one at a time. The model is available through a limited API trial from June 9 to June 23. It costs three times the standard MiMo-V2.5-Pro rate for roughly 10 times the output.
summary: 小米与推理合作伙伴 TileRT 推出了 MiMo-V2.5-Pro-UltraSpeed 模型，这是一个拥有 1 万亿参数的模型，在标准 8-GPU 节点上实现了每秒 1000 token 的推理速度，比 ChatGPT 和 Claude 快 15 倍。该速度通过 FP4 量化和 DFlash 推测解码实现，展示了超大规模模型高效推理的新路径。

title: 仅4B大小可端侧部署！卡帕西预言的「认知模型」被国产做出来了
summary: 国内团队成功开发出仅 4B 参数、可端侧部署的“认知模型”，效果比肩 GPT-5.4。该模型实现了 Andrej Karpathy 预言的认知模型架构，在保持小体积的同时具备强大的推理能力，为手机、IoT 设备等端侧场景提供了高性能 AI 方案，有望推动 AI 应用从云端向终端迁移。

title: Introducing FrontierCode
raw_excerpt: FrontierCode is a benchmark that measures how well models can truly meet the standards of high-quality production databases. It is the first benchmark to measure code mergeability. The benchmark was crafted by open-source maintainers and features an extensive QC pipeline with adversarial testing, calibration, and multi-stage review. It provides the strongest signal of a model's ability to write high-quality, maintainable code.
summary: Cognition AI 发布了 FrontierCode 基准测试，这是首个衡量代码可合并性的基准，旨在评估模型编写高质量、可维护生产代码的能力。该基准由开源维护者精心设计，包含对抗性测试、校准和多阶段审查流程，为评估 AI 编码能力提供了更贴近实际工程场景的信号。

title: Introducing North Mini Code: Cohere’s First Model For Developers
summary: Cohere 发布了其首个面向开发者的模型 North Mini Code，专为代码生成和理解任务优化。该模型在保持轻量级的同时，在代码补全、解释和调试等场景中表现出色，为开发者提供了高效、低成本的本地代码 AI 助手选择，进一步丰富了开源代码模型生态。

title: Amazon employees ask Seattle to put the brakes on new data centers
raw_excerpt: On Tuesday, the Seattle City Council will vote on whether to enact a one-year moratorium on new data centers - just two months after several companies proposed building five large-scale centers in the city. Among the moratorium's fiercest supporters are current employees from the city's biggest tech giant, Amazon, who joined others to testify in support of the policy last week. Data centers have sparked protests across the country over concerns about water consumption, local electricity prices, and noise. summary: 西雅图市议会即将投票决定是否实施为期一年的新数据中心建设暂停令，而亚马逊员工成为该政策的最强烈支持者之一。员工们因担忧数据中心的巨大能耗、水资源消耗和噪音问题而公开反对公司扩张。这一事件凸显了 AI 算力需求与社区环保诉求之间的尖锐矛盾。
